purpose: Connect education, civic participation, entrepreneurship, community capacity, and population strategy into one human-development engine — how Arkansas turns people, knowledge, relationships, communities, and place into productive capital and makes people want to build their lives here.
one_sentence: Arkansas increases each person's capability to create value, exercise agency, acquire ownership, and contribute — through multiple upward pathways — while communities compound human, financial, social, civic, and place capital so people stay, return, and belong.
governing_question: How does Arkansas turn people, knowledge, relationships, communities and place into productive capital—and make people want to build their lives here?
harvest_rule: Integrate existing education, HYP-133, public research/IP, residency, military/civic service, local organizing, rural prosperity, and retain/attract substance — do not reopen research campaigns.

countable_discipline.rule: Bind Demand Map relationship; do not deeply build HYP-133 this pass

capability_ladder.rule: Not one forced path — multiple upward pathways, same objective
capability_ladder.objective: Increase the individual's capability to create value, exercise agency, acquire ownership and contribute to Arkansas

demand_map_join.operating_loop: Arkansas Needs → Demand Map → Education/Training Capacity → Skills → Employment/Enterprise → Ownership → Arkansas Production → New Demand Signals
demand_map_join.note: Structural home for Demand Map established; empirical first pass remains Stage 2/4 deferred — bind and move

forms.label: Cultural / Place Capital
forms.meaning: identity, heritage, environment, characteristics that make somewhere worth living

community_capital_forms.insight: A town can receive millions in outside investment while deteriorating if it loses the other four forms of capital.

prosperity_cycle_integration.cycle: Human Capability → Productive Work/Enterprise → Arkansas Production → Money Engine → Household Prosperity → Savings/Ownership/Security/Time → Children/Education/Community → Greater Human Capability
prosperity_cycle_integration.alongside: Democratic Power → rules → markets → economic outcomes → distribution of power → democratic power (Pass 2.4 territory)

contradictions.note: No natural resolution this pass. CX-M21-01 and CX-M21-02 remain open.

modules.name: Early Childhood & Family Foundation
modules.now: Capability begins before school; Arkansas families carry early development unevenly with childcare/time pressure (HP-07).
modules.problem: Treating school as the first human-capital institution ignores the family foundation where agency and readiness form.
modules.future_state: Families supported as the first human-capital institution; early capability reduces later remediation and raises lifetime surplus.
modules.mechanism: Integrate family/childcare frameworks with Capability Ladder entry (CHILD); join HP-07 care economy and HP-01 participation — harvest, do not reopen.
modules.money_flow: Household care/education spend + public early supports → providers/capacity. Leakage: inaccessible care forcing wage loss and time poverty.
modules.ownership: Families retain primary authority; community early-care capacity is shared infrastructure.
modules.household_effect: More surplus and time; children enter school ready; parents can work/own without collapse.
modules.government_role: Enable capacity and supports; avoid one-size family doctrine.
modules.market_role: Providers compete on quality/access under fair rules.
modules.transition: Expand capacity before conditioning supports that crush working families.
modules.risks: Benefit cliffs; quality failure; cultural overreach.
modules.measurement: Early readiness proxies; care access; unpaid care hours.
modules.deferred_validation: Arkansas early-childhood access binds; Stage 4 cliff tests

modules.name: K–12 Education & Civic Capability
modules.now: K–12 is often credential-centered; civic capability and productive adulthood pathways are uneven across place.
modules.problem: Credentials without capability and citizenship fail the Capability Ladder objective.
modules.future_state: Education builds knowledge, capability, citizenship, and pathways into productive adulthood — multiple routes upward.
modules.mechanism: Curriculum and pathway design toward Ladder stages STUDENT→SKILLED ADULT; civic education joins popular sovereignty/citizenship frameworks; Demand Map informs local pathway options without dictating one track.
modules.money_flow: Public education appropriations + household costs → schools. Success measured by capability outcomes, not spend alone.
modules.ownership: Public education as civic infrastructure; families and communities share voice.
modules.household_effect: Children gain agency and options; less dead-end tracking.
modules.government_role: Standards, funding fairness, civic content floor; local pathway flexibility.
modules.market_role: Supplementary providers exist; core civic capability is public.
modules.transition: Improve pathways inside existing schools before wholesale disruption.
modules.risks: Culture-war capture; testing-only metrics; rural/urban template mismatch.
modules.measurement: Pathway completion; civic literacy proxies; post-exit outcomes.
modules.deferred_validation: Outcome panels by district type; Stage 4

modules.name: Higher Education, Technical & Lifelong Learning
modules.now: Universities, community colleges, trades, and reskilling exist but are weakly coupled to Arkansas Needs → Demand Map signals.
modules.problem: Educate→hope-jobs model wastes human capital and leaks talent.
modules.future_state: Postsecondary and lifelong learning track Arkansas Needs → capacity → skills → employment/enterprise → ownership → production → new demand signals.
modules.mechanism: Bind Demand Map as structural operating loop (relationship only); connect CTE/apprenticeship/college to ME-04 ownership and local employers; continuous reskilling for AI/productivity without COUNTABLE fiction.
modules.money_flow: Tuition/public appropriation/employer spend → institutions → graduate earnings/ownership. Leakage: credentials that export talent without Arkansas return paths.
modules.ownership: Learners own skills; public share of publicly financed IP via HC-04; employers co-invest in training.
modules.household_effect: Higher earnings/ownership odds; less debt without pathway.
modules.government_role: Align capacity to Demand Map; fund public options; publish outcomes.
modules.market_role: Employers signal demand; private trainers compete.
modules.transition: Bind relationship now; deepen HYP-133 empirics later — do not stop Stage 2 to research.
modules.risks: Reopening HYP-133 research sprawl; overclaiming job guarantees.
modules.measurement: In-state employment/ownership of completers; time-to-productivity; reskill uptake.
modules.evidence_status: WORKING — Demand Map relationship bound; empirics deferred
modules.deferred_validation: HYP-133 Demand Map empirical first pass; Stage 4

modules.name: Research, Innovation & Arkansas IP
modules.now: Public research creates knowledge and IP; commercialization and Arkansas return are often thin; COUNTABLE public claim remains gated.
modules.problem: Public investment in knowledge without return pathways exports prosperity.
modules.future_state: Research → IP → commercialization → researcher/university return → Arkansas prosperity under transparent public claim rules.
modules.mechanism: Integrate prior public-IP framing with ME-03/ME-07 enterprise/prosperity joins; researcher and university share; Arkansas commercialization preference without autarky.
modules.money_flow: Public R&D → IP → licenses/spinouts → returns to university/public/households. Leakage: out-of-state capture of publicly funded IP.
modules.ownership: Shared claims: inventor, institution, public contribution proportional where designed.
modules.household_effect: High-skill jobs; possible ownership in spinouts; better services from applied research.
modules.government_role: Fund research; set IP return rules; refuse COUNTABLE without free cash.
modules.market_role: Private commercialization partners under anti-extraction covenants.
modules.transition: Clarify claim rules before expanding spend claims.
modules.risks: Stifling invention; COUNTABLE inflation; capture by connected firms.
modules.measurement: In-state commercialization share; return cash to ledgers; spinout retention.

modules.name: Entrepreneurship & Local Ownership Pipeline
modules.now: Skill→work exists; skill→enterprise→ownership→employer→community capital is incomplete for many Arkansans.
modules.problem: Wage-only adulthood stalls the Capability Ladder before OWNER/ENTREPRENEUR.
modules.future_state: Clear pipeline: skill → work → enterprise → ownership → employer → community capital.
modules.mechanism: Integrate ME-04 ownership ladder, ME-02 credit, HC-03 pathways, and place supports (HC-07); Ladder pathway Work→Ownership explicit.
modules.money_flow: Savings/credit → startups → local surplus retention (ME-08). Leakage: PE extraction and HQ flight.
modules.ownership: Founders, workers, community investors as designed.
modules.household_effect: Assets and agency beyond wages; local multiplier.
modules.government_role: Enable formation, credit, procurement; do not pick every winner.
modules.market_role: Primary discovery mechanism under anti-extraction rules.
modules.measurement: Formation rates; local ownership share; 5-year survival in-state.
modules.deferred_validation: Rural vs metro pathway mix; Stage 4

modules.name: Civic & Community Service Capital
modules.now: Military, volunteerism, teaching, civic work, and leadership create value poorly reciprocated into opportunity and wealth pathways.
modules.problem: Service treated as sacrifice without reciprocal capability/ownership pathways.
modules.future_state: Service is investment — reciprocal pathways to education, ownership, and community leadership (Military→Community pathway on Ladder).
modules.mechanism: Integrate citizen-service and military-transition substance; link service to HC-03 education benefits and HC-05 ownership on-ramps; civic capital form explicit.
modules.money_flow: Public recognition/benefits + community support → service members/volunteers → local capacity. Not a new COUNTABLE engine by slogan.
modules.ownership: Service builds civic capital owned by communities; individuals gain portable benefits/ownership on-ramps.
modules.household_effect: Status, skills, education/ownership access after service.
modules.government_role: Design reciprocal pathways; honor without empty symbolism.
modules.market_role: Employers value service skills; community orgs host leadership.
modules.transition: Expand pathways inside existing GI/benefit bridges.
modules.measurement: Pathway uptake; leadership retention in place; veteran/enterprise outcomes.

modules.name: Place, Community & Local Capacity
modules.now: Counties/cities/towns often receive programs from Little Rock without compounding local institutional competence.
modules.problem: Program delivery without community capital leaves places dependent and brittle.
modules.future_state: Places develop institutions, leadership, networks, and productive capacity — all five community capital forms.
modules.mechanism: Community Capital Pentagon as operating checklist; integrate build-your-community, community prosperity, and rural/urban substance; local capacity before one-size state programs.
modules.money_flow: State/federal transfers → local institutions → retained productive assets or leakage to consultants/absentee vendors.
modules.ownership: Local institutions and residents own capacity; outside capital joins under retention rules.
modules.household_effect: Services that work; belonging; local opportunity.
modules.government_role: Enable local capacity; subsidiarity; measure five capitals not only dollars spent.
modules.market_role: Local enterprise embeds in place networks.
modules.transition: Build local competence before centralizing more programs.
modules.measurement: Institutional competence proxies; five-capital scorecards; dependency ratios.

modules.name: Population: Retain, Return & Attract
modules.now: Arkansas loses people, underuses return pathways, and attracts unevenly; newcomers may not convert into belonging/ownership (HYP-132 sensitivity — not revenue).
modules.problem: Population strategy as tourism marketing fails; without belonging/ownership, attraction leaks.
modules.future_state: KEEP Arkansans → BRING Arkansans home → ATTRACT needed talent → CONVERT arrival into belonging/ownership.
modules.mechanism: Integrate HYP-132 retain/attract architecture; join HC-05 ownership, HC-07 place, HP surplus; Demand Map informs who is strategically needed — sensitivity only, not COUNTABLE revenue.
modules.money_flow: Household location decisions ↔ local surplus/amenity/ownership. Fiscal effects are sensitivity, not engine cash.
modules.ownership: Newcomers and returners enter ownership/civic pathways; communities own welcome institutions.
modules.government_role: Strategy and welcome infrastructure; no fake population-as-revenue claims.
modules.market_role: Employers and housing markets shape retention under anti-extraction rules.
modules.transition: Fix retain/return before chasing high-cost attraction theater.
modules.risks: Counting migrants as COUNTABLE revenue; cultural backlash; empty attraction spend.
modules.measurement: Net migration by type; return rates; newcomer ownership/civic uptake.
modules.deferred_validation: Composition binds; Stage 4 — never promote to COUNTABLE without evidence
